name: Gorezono
source:
A tsundere metalhead high school girl suddenly transferred to Ushiro's class.
Her true identity is a zombie girl who can instantly recover from any fatal injury! She's currently spewing blood and guts all over the school!
She grows cat ears and a tail when talking about metal.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01633087.html]DLsite[/url]]
